svg.title: dsh-talk two-way voice loop: the browser take (mic button, MediaRecorder + VAD) crosses the talk/transcribe gate into the host engine ladder (FunASR, whisper.cpp, or the browser Web Speech), the transcript returns to the composer as a draft, the turn hinge hands it to the agent, and the speak() tool runs the mirror TTS ladder (piper, edge-tts, browser voice) into the audio cache and the bounded export directory before playback crosses back through talk/audio; the interrupt rail closes the loop on the left, and the settings write-back runs underneath
